scale_consequences.equal_magnitude_condition: |kappa|=1 gives equal leading |s_j| at all four A1 nodes; kappa=1 gives the simplest real equal-scale path
scale_consequences.spotti_scale_relation: For local equation z1^2+z2^2+z3^2=s, Spotti uses delta^2=sqrt(|s|), hence equal |s_j| gives equal EH diameters/scales up to common constants in matched coordinates.
scale_consequences.matched_control_use: If this path is identified with the all-same-chirality KE degeneration in the Biquard-Ozuch chart, its radial equation gives s_self + d_same_diag + 2*c_same_adj = 0 at each coefficient layer visible in the matched expansion. This is a conditional coefficient relation, not an automatic conclusion for mixed chirality.
